_comment: Pore definitions for md_channel_analysis.py. Residue indices are 0-based MDAnalysis resindex values of the CHARMM-GUI builds (AQP4 3GD8 residues 32-254 are resindex 0-222 per chain; OmpF 2OMF residues 1-340 are resindex 0-339 per chain). Extents are relative to the centroid of point_selection (plus point_offset_A when given) along the axis, in the coordinates of the first analysed frame (start_frame), to which every frame is fitted. The entries without a suffix are the definitions fixed before the trajectories were analysed and are kept unchanged as the record (only their description text was corrected on 1 Nov 2026 against the .tpr/.mdp/.log of each run). For the AQP4 builds two of those choices proved wrong (z is not the pore axis of the tilted tetramer, and the NPA ND2 centroid lies beside the water lumen); the *_v2 entries correct them and say what changed in v2_note. See benchmarks/nongeom/md_systems/aqp4.md.

aqp4_monomer_porewaters.definition_status: Pre-registered definition, kept as the record. resindex values are right (65/181 = Asn97/Asn213 ND2). It proved unsuitable: the Asn97/Asn213 ND2 centroid lies 3.05 A beside the pore-water centre line, so the 3 A cylinder holds only part of the lumen (strict convention 1 event, pf changes 28x between radii 2 and 6 A). Compartment event counts were robust (57 vs 59). Corrected: aqp4_monomer_porewaters_v2. Results: benchmarks/nongeom/md_systems/aqp4.md

ompf_trimer_efield.description: OmpF (2OMF) trimer, 1 M KCl, static 0.05 V/nm along z (+z extracellular), 100 ns, frames every 100 ps

system.build: CHARMM-GUI (PDB 2OMF, biological trimer, chains PROA/P2PROA/P3PROA, residues 1-340, NTER/CTER) repaired locally: protein moved +7.18 A along z onto the OPM membrane depth (CHARMM-GUI had translated it 7.2 A too deep; tilt 0.01 deg), overlapping lipids/waters/ions removed whole, 793 TIP3 waters placed in the three dry barrels, neutrality restored, minimised locally (5126 steepest-descent steps)
system.orientation: OPM; N and C termini (periplasmic side) below the bilayer midplane, so +z is extracellular
system.lipids: 354 DOPE + 117 DOPG (3:1); upper leaflet 180 DOPE + 58 DOPG, lower 174 DOPE + 59 DOPG
system.ions: 1001 K+, 848 Cl- (1.0 M from the Cl- count; bulk slab more than 25 A from the bilayer midplane: 1.11 M K+, 1.06 M Cl- over the run); excess K+ neutralises DOPG (-117 e) and the protein (-12 e per chain)
system.force_field: CHARMM36m protein with CHARMM36 lipids, ions and TIP3P water, built with CHARMM-GUI (topology from its FF-Converter); release stated by the system's author
system.temperature: 310 K, v-rescale, tau_t 1 ps, groups SOLU MEMB SOLV
system.pressure: C-rescale, semi-isotropic, 1 bar, tau_p 5 ps, compressibility 4.5e-5 1/bar
system.field: electric-field-z = 0.050 0 0 0: E0 0.05 V/nm, omega 0, t0 0, sigma 0 (static), production only; V = E0 x mean Lz = 561 mV (Lz 112.15 +- 0.90 A)
system.integration: dt 2 fs, LINCS h-bonds, PME (rcoulomb 1.2 nm, Fourier spacing 0.12 nm), Lennard-Jones cut-off 1.2 nm with force switch from 1.0 nm
system.com_removal: comm-mode linear, nstcomm 100, comm-grps SOLU_MEMB SOLV (the solvent's centre-of-mass velocity is removed separately from the protein and membrane, which damps net solvent flow through the pores)
